nested_array_origin_gc.description: B inserts into nested array whose parent A deletes. Origin resolves to GC struct.

nested_text_origin_gc.description: B appends to nested YText that A replaces via map.set. Origin resolves to GC.

nested_array_right_origin_gc.description: B inserts at pos 0 of nested array. rightOrigin resolves to GC struct.

nested_array_both_origins_gc.description: B inserts in middle of nested array. Both origin and rightOrigin are GC.

full_handshake.description: Full SyncStep1/SyncStep2 handshake between two docs
